PR.title: Add retained delivery authority and immutable tag-only execution
PR.body:
## Scope And Immutable Lineage
Assigned fix for Robin's historical/current environment reassessment on f00217b9cb41d7a2a024364286846ca608f1fea0. Original task 01M6BVRRQ91W62063MKY6PDEYK, approved revision b1d627ef0544cc0a61b0d75474520506071cb08f4024cd40da64c213eddcb6ae / approval2, source actors and original bindings remain unchanged. The stacked base remains agent/hawk/e0642638a17acc68 at reviewed PR161 e55da25979087dfb16ef23226263435c14c45fe9, freshly reverified remotely. Preserve original PR161 task/assignment/commits/publication/review/QA/journals and predecessor bundle 8c206e9e3fe590dd6a1e861fcd122b453ac4aa00b6b8e16934c2680e9d1c5f6e as immutable inputs, not inherited clearance or cross-revision dependencies. The prior fix publication completed under its original request; it was not replayed.

## Environment Fix
Historical source QA is now compared to the original retained SourceEnvironment and SourceEnvironmentRevision, not the current top-level delivery environment. Native source-QA verification and original report IDs/body digests remain strict and unchanged. Current delivery environment authority is independently revalidated at retained tag selection/action/confirmation using the same exact-artifact reassessment resolver as retained delivery. Master tag authorization/validation also rechecks that current environment authority. Tag input/source-delivery equality and tag-specific owner/readiness-report environment bindings remain exact.

Combined regression fixtures renew delivery environment before independent readiness and the original retained merge, then traverse both source-only and subsequent-version-PR tag paths with three distinct identities: historical staging/staging-v1, current delivery container/container-v2, tag QA tag-device/tag-device-v3. They cover selection, action, lost-ref response, zero-write read-only observation and same-request authorized confirmation. Negatives for historical environment/revision mismatch, current delivery environment/revision or authority drift, tag environment/report drift and source-proof digest mismatch assert zero tag effects and no native completion. Premerge negatives assert zero merge effects. Master regression preserves source evidence and original completion while denying tag authorization/confirmation when current environment authority disappears.

## Verification
The new combined journeys failed deterministically before the production correction. After the fix: full go test -count=1 ./..., full go test -race ./..., focused environment race count3, build, vet, format, golangci-lint2.12.2 (0 issues), govulncheck1.6.0 (no vulnerabilities), Python packaging58 and root installer23 pass. Tools: Go1.26.10 linux/arm64, Flox1.18.1, existing GCC15.3.0 for race; umask022 and root DAC-bypass capabilities dropped. Full suites used the authorized external COOP_PR9_PRIVATE_FIXTURE; private original records were not staged or published. Public CI still explicitly skips exact-private evidence tests without authorized input. Matching hosted CI on the changed head remains required.

## Capability And Operator Packet
The bounded delta provides separate authenticated retained-gates/retained-deliver authority, independently assigned Hawk/Wren readiness, original-task Rook delivery, and a distinct immutable Rook-only tag-only stage. Exact native source/version delivery/completion provenance, integrated commits/trees and source/payload equivalence stay bound. Durable object/ref intent precedes effects; uncertain writes never replay; observation changes no local/remote state. The earlier cross-kind supersession, live owner decide revocation, renewed-environment applicability and conclusive429/403 refusal fixes remain in place.

Actual schemas, commands, hold-preserving activation/withdrawal/rollback packet and contract map: docs/retained-delivery-activation.md (updated with the three-environment contract and regressions). Native digest CLI: docs/native-authority-digests.md. Tag lifecycle/recovery: docs/tag-only-integration.md.

This is author verification only. Fresh Robin exact-head review and separate Wren exact-artifact QA under rook-retained-delivery-tag-only-v2 are required; previous-head approval/QA does not clear this change. No self-review, live merge/tag, installation/restart/config activation, hold lifting, release/workflow/assets or tap action. Operator alone owns activation and later exact PR9/tag decisions. Original gh-sweep goal/assignment/policy/source and private evidence remain unchanged. PR158/159 external-owner admission is a separate limitation, never a PR9 prerequisite. Cross-service final-guard/effect races, byte-identical uncertain foreign effects, missing original completion proof and unsupported cross-placement tag adoption remain disclosed fail-closed/operator boundaries.

Independent Robin review of exact head 35c931a676dd4f57a7179a1f34821b76fabe3b1b, stacked on e55da25979087dfb16ef23226263435c14c45fe9. Changes needed.

1. [P1] Use one supersession rule for ordinary and retained delivery before any merge. internal/worker/native_delivery_authority.go:45-50 unconditionally prefers a retained decision whenever that kind exists; internal/worker/native_retained.go:37-54 selects only within that kind. Master completion instead selects the newest decision across deliver and retained-deliver (internal/master/tasks.go:395-404). A newer ordinary grant or its withdrawal therefore does not stop an older retained grant from merging, although the master will reject its completion. An isolated overlay regression added a valid higher-sequence ordinary decision after retained admission, then called the production RunNativeAction: it returned completed and issued PUT pulls/1/merge and PATCH issues/1 using the superseded retained grant. Select the newest delivery decision across both kinds consistently at discovery, action, confirmation and completion; then validate its kind/scope/revocation without fallback. Add cross-kind replacement and withdrawal tests asserting zero writes.

2. [P1] Revalidate current retained-owner authority before the external merge, not only during task completion. internal/worker/native_retained.go:91-92,143-173,231-240 checks recorded owner kind and current thread membership, but never whether the grant owner or owner-evidence author still has decide. nativeValidateDelivery only checks this worker snapshot (internal/worker/native_delivery_authority.go:81-105); there is no authenticated retained-authority validation equivalent to tag-only's master validation. Removing the owner's decide capability while preserving membership leaves the worker's inputs valid. Master TaskComplete then freshly authorizes the owner and rejects (internal/master/tasks.go:406-412), after the merge can already have happened. I verified with a master fixture that supported Store.Configure removal of decide leaves ResolveGoal valid and the same handoffs/messages readable, while completion refuses. Require fresh master-side validation of both retained gate/delivery owners and evidence authority immediately before effects and recovery completion; test capability revocation without a membership or handoff change and assert zero merge writes.

3. [P2] Preserve conclusive rate-limit refusals in the tag-ref journal. internal/worker/native_tag_only.go:150-158 records ref-rejected only for GitHubError with a 4xx StatusCode. The production GitHub client drops that status for HTTP 429 and rate-limited HTTP 403 (internal/worker/github.go:129-130), so those definite refusals remain ref-intent. If an independent writer then publishes the same ref/object, retrying the original action adopts it and records completed success. I reproduced both 429 and 403 through the production GitHub response parser and RunNativeAction: the initial ref POST was refused with no ref created, a foreign equal ref was then supplied, and the same-request retry returned completed. Preserve the response status and apply the conclusive-refusal rule to these responses; regressions must refuse adoption and persist no completed receipt.

4. [P2] Validate the renewed current environment separately from the historical source environment. internal/master/retained_delivery.go:67-73 validates Retained.SourceEnvironment/SourceEnvironmentRevision only; it never checks top-level Environment/EnvironmentRevision against the approved QA environment or an applicable reassess-qa environment decision. The ordinary delivery validator does that at internal/master/handoffs.go:331-335. Worker retained validation likewise checks only the source environment at internal/worker/native_retained.go:189-193. A regression changing only the current environment and revision to nonempty unapproved values, retaining the valid historical source pins and no reassessment decision, successfully created retained-gates. Exact renewed-report equality then binds those unchecked values rather than establishing environment applicability. Validate both environment identities independently at grant, admission/action and completion, including current-only environment/revision drift tests.

Validation: repository checkout remained unchanged; regression files are outside the repository and were loaded with Go -overlay. Flox 1.18.1 / Go 1.26.10 linux/arm64. Existing focused Retained|TagOnly|AuthorityDigest tests pass; full go test ./... passes; focused master/worker retained/tag-only race tests with count=2 pass; go build ./... and go vet ./... pass. Permission fixtures were run with umask 022 and root DAC-bypass capabilities dropped. Hosted test and lint checks are successful for this head. These passing suites do not cover the reproduced failures above. Exact private-original PR9 fixture tests skip without COOP_PR9_PRIVATE_FIXTURE in this review environment; I do not claim that private journey or Wren QA clearance. No source implementation changes, live merge/tag, installation, restart, configuration mutation or hold lifting performed.

Independent Robin reassessment of exact head f00217b9cb41d7a2a024364286846ca608f1fea0 under the newly assigned dismissed-review stage. Changes needed. I confirmed the operator-reported deployment blocker; my earlier approval missed this historical/current environment separation and must not be treated as clearance. This is a new assigned assessment, not replay of the completed prior review action.

[P1] Validate historical source QA against its retained source environment, not the current delivery environment. At internal/worker/native_tag_only_bridge.go:107-110, nativeTagOnlyRetainedSource obtains the original source QA result but compares result.Environment/EnvironmentRevision to tag.Input.Environment/EnvironmentRevision. TagOnlySourceMatches at internal/coordination/tag_only.go:52-59 intentionally binds those top-level tag fields to the retained delivery's CURRENT environment. That current environment can be explicitly renewed independently of the immutable historical source environment. Thus a valid retained delivery with historical hermetic/staging QA and current container-v2 readiness can complete but its later tag-only candidate is rejected even though the original QA evidence remains valid. Both direct-source and version-tag paths use this retained-source gate. This blocks the approved historical-to-current environment transition rather than merely documenting a runtime limitation.

Independent reproduction at this exact head: I added only an outside-repository Go-overlay test, TestRobinReviewTagHistoricalEnvironmentSeparation. tagOnlyFixture admits one baseline candidate. I then represented a retained delivery and matching tag top-level environment of container/container-v2, left historical QA and Retained.SourceEnvironment/SourceEnvironmentRevision unchanged at staging/staging-v1, used a distinct tag QA environment tag-device/tag-device-v3, and recomputed only the corresponding source-input digest and renewed tag-readiness report bindings. Both handoff schemas, TagOnlySourceMatches, nativeTagOnlySourceProof, nativeTagOnlyReadRoster and nativeQAState pass; the historical result exactly matches the unchanged retained SOURCE environment. NativeTagOnlyCandidates nevertheless returns zero because nativeTagOnlyRetainedSource rejects the historical/current comparison. The regression fails deterministically on f00217b.

Required correction: compare the historical QA result with source.Input.Retained.SourceEnvironment and SourceEnvironmentRevision. Preserve immutable source QA, original report IDs/body digests and source environment; do not relabel historical evidence or weaken nativeQAState. Continue independently enforcing current retained-delivery/top-level tag environment equality, applicable current environment authority, and exact tag-specific environment/readiness-report bindings. Add end-to-end retained delivery through source-only and version-PR tag selection/action/confirmation coverage with distinct historical, current-delivery and tag QA environments. Add negatives for historical QA/source-environment mismatch, current delivery environment/authority drift, tag environment/report drift and source proof digest mismatch, with zero external effects on denial.
